programs.title: Raju Chacha
programs.desc: Raju is hired to pose as uncle to three orphaned kids in order to usurp their inheritance. But he changes his mind after falling in love with their governess and decides to fight the greedy relatives.

programs.title: Krishna Cottage
programs.desc: The movie revolves around a group of college students who visit a haunted house called "Krishna Cottage." As they unravel the mystery behind the house, they uncover dark secrets and a vengeful spirit that haunts them

programs.title: Dharam Chakara (dharam Chakaram Tamil 1997)
programs.desc: A village leader who loses a fight to his enemy Arumugam, causing the death of his lover Vijayalakshmi. Years later, another woman named Vijayalakshmi enters the village, and Chakkaravarthy defends her from Arumugam's goons, rekindling his fight for justice.

programs.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programs.desc: Raju comes to Bombay chasing his dreams, but keeps losing out on opportunities. His love, Renu helps him find a job. Success goes to his head until one day a tragic accident destroys his reputation.
